clips.title: The story
paras: Beside Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe supplies miners and prospectors and receives dispatches for couriers and travelers.

At Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe outfits prospectors and craftsmen with the necessities of their trade. He sells sturdy mining picks, flux, and coal, supplies that fuel the smelting fires and smithies that define the dwarven capital. Kin to Geofram Bouldertoe, Golnir is a reliable contact for workers arriving in the city. He directs fresh hands and receives supply messages carried from nearby outposts.
